name: com.android.linkboost.multi.acc.service.LinkBoostService
description: When an app requests Tencent LinkBoost MPACC acceleration, this foreground VPN service sets up a tunnel, monitors available network paths, and connects them to the multipath engine.
disableEffect: LinkBoost cannot establish its accelerated network route, so app features that rely on MPACC may lose connectivity or responsiveness.
